methods.label: Express the denominator using bases 2 and 3
methods.explanation:
Use \(6=2\cdot3\) to put the numerator and denominator in the same bases:
\[
\frac{2^{2001}\cdot3^{2003}}{6^{2002}}
=\frac{2^{2001}\cdot3^{2003}}{2^{2002}\cdot3^{2002}}.
\]
Cancel the common, nonzero factors \(2^{2001}\) and \(3^{2002}\). One factor of \(3\) remains in the numerator, and one factor of \(2\) remains in the denominator. Thus the ratio is \(\frac32\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
methods.levelReason: Only positive-integer exponent laws and cancellation of common factors are needed.

candidate.annotationRationale: The assessed procedures are the product-power identity and division of same-base powers. Splitting off factors uses same-base multiplication, and cancellation uses the basic fraction property. No real-exponent or negative-exponent extension is needed.
